roles.name: 运行时与内存
roles.goal: R1-M1-READY-BATCH-004: Add an owner-local bounded ready-only <=32 batch drain to existing TxOwner, preserving Fresh first on first dispatch and alternating fair repair/parity progress; reuse caller-provided preallocated output storage, no per-batch ciphertext clone, and maintain absolute MonoNs deadlines/stop/return ownership. Must not implement syscalls or modify root dependency/driver.
roles.done_when: Exact own SOURCE compiled-once native r1_ tests: empty/1/32/33 packet batch capacity, full independent repair/parity vs fresh, first systematic ahead of due/undue parity, bounded secondary progress under persistent fresh, stop and last frozen loan/return. Keep all preceding M1 tests and own evidence S/H/Governance; no production SPSC/loom/eventfd claim.

roles.name: 恢复与反馈
roles.goal: R2-M2-GLOBAL-BATCH-COMPLETION-003: Extend pure wbd-recovery global allocator for bounded batch completion bookkeeping over independently reserved repair candidates from multiple TunnelKey/directions. Accept a platform-agnostic validated result representation (accepted prefix, at most one uncertain slot, suffix definitely NotAttempted only with evidence), never depend on platform crate. Preserve original-epoch NotSent refunds, Uncertain debit, duplicate/old callbacks fail closed and process hard quota; do not touch M0 engine sender.
roles.done_when: Exact own SOURCE compiled-once native r2_ fake-MonoNs tests for 0/1/32/33 mapping, accepted prefix vs ambiguous index and not-attempted suffix, two tunnels/both directions, epoch cutover, double completion, expired/departed grants and fresh not HOL. Preserve 22 previous r2_ tests; S/evidence/H and Governance. No raw sendmmsg product/driver or root Cargo changes.

roles.name: 编码与数据保护
roles.goal: R1-M3-FEC-RETIRE-PRESSURE-010: Strengthen bounded FecRxOwner and FecBlockIdOwner heavy→compact→retired under capacity and timer pressure, including authenticated-input multi-block out-of-order systematic/final parity, no duplicate business resurrection and valid first-source delivery. Only codec own files; do not invent a trusted Go V4 exporter or modify authenticated input provenance.
roles.done_when: Exact SOURCE compiled-once native r1_ deterministic fake-MonoNs tests: 3s heavy/10s compact, late callbacks, small heavy/compact byte caps, BlockID wrap across trusted explicit generation, wrong epoch/direction/half-space, old parity and malformed final conflict, 20:R parity profile and known Go 56B oracle; rejected/late never reopen retired data. Retain earlier 67 r1_ tests and own S/evidence/H/Governance. New implementation only if failing counterexample proves necessary.

roles.name: 平台与产品接入
roles.goal: R1-M4-IPV4-TCP-RX-PARSE-004: Add strict, bounded IPv4/TCP one-full-DATA-packet byte parser for incoming carrier packets with trusted tuple/MTU/length/flags/options and independent IP/TCP pseudoheader checksum validation. Provide caller-anchored seq32→u64 nearest extension with fail-closed half-space ambiguity; do not implement arbitrary TCP stream reassembly or real AF_PACKET live reader.
roles.done_when: Exact own SOURCE compiled-once platform r1_ tests on byte-exact existing IPv4/TCP writer outputs, checksums independently, version/IHL/options/total length/data offset truncation, fragments, malformed flags, wrong tuple/source or checksum, MTU±1 and seq32 wrap/half-space ambiguity, back-to-back unrelated packet not HOL; no pre-auth payload ever treated as verified business. Own S/evidence/H/Governance. Kernel raw RX/Windows/physical NOT_RUN.
